shared_instructions: VC server-readiness review. Read-only: no edits, no commits, no server starts, no network writes. Never print secret values (env NAMES only). Cite file:line.

task.purpose: Owner asks: is the AI part built as proper runtime code (typed function tool calls executed by our code) or did we just drop SKILL.md files and rely on Claude Code? Any Claude dependency that breaks it on a server without Claude Code?
acceptance: Inspect packages/engine/src/skills/loader.ts and repo-root skills/*/SKILL.md (how prompts load and validate; missing or malformed file = boot throw or silent fallback?); packages/engine/src/student/graph.ts (capability manifest ~637-695, nodes, tool invocation); packages/providers/src/live.ts (~895 functionDeclarations) and packages/providers/src/index.ts (Gemini/Ollama/LiteLLM via VC_LLM_PROVIDER/VC_LLM_MODEL); mcp/pathlynks, mcp/student-profile, mcp/university-kb (in-process functions or separate processes that must be started?); packages/engine/src/guards (deterministic vs LLM).

Answer: (1) typed schema function calling executed by our code, or prose skill calls? (2) SKILL.md = prompt templates read by our loader, or Claude Code skill semantics assumed? (3) any runtime Anthropic/Claude SDK or Claude Code use? (4) which external AI endpoints must be reachable and behaviour when down (fail closed/degrade/crash)? (5) top 3 real production risks in the AI layer. Cite file:line. Under 500 words.
checks: No edits, no server starts, no secret values.
